### Files included in the build artifact

Most users should use the **`picoboot_bt2w_full.uf2`** file (full package). The other files are intended for advanced users to update only specific parts of the firmware or payload.

| File Name                 | Platform        | Description                       |
| ------------------------- | --------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `picoboot_bt2w_full.uf2`  | Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W | firmware + payload (full package) |
| `picoboot.uf2`            | Pico 2 W        | firmware only                     |
| `payload_pico2.uf2`       | Pico 2 W        | payload                           |
